description: A computer rider riding between the chase camera and the player's craft fades out (JetSkiModel.fade, a dither), and fades back in once it is clear; the craft the camera follows never fades. In watch mode the camera follows another racer, and the player's craft in the way fades instead (issue #71).

steps.name: Koa rides 3.5 m behind Marina, in her camera's line of sight
Koa is faded; Marina and the riders far behind aren't
Koa moves alongside, out of the way
watching Koa, with Marina behind him
the followed craft doesn't fade; the one in the way does
